content:
manny_sales: Quick sync — Synapse Labs wants to run a POC with their custom Synapse-7B-v2 variant. Requirements: p95 tail latency <120ms, 1M tokens/day, and customer-managed keys (KMS). Can we onboard this into the catalog for a Dedicated POC?
elaine_devx: Short answer: probably yes, but need a couple checks: tokenizer compat, kv-cache layout, and whether runtime needs a small shim for RMSNorm vs LayerNorm kernels. Also confirm mode of deployment (Dedicated vs Private).
jordan_ml: Did a brief spike on their tarball. Model looks Llama-ish, uses RMSNorm, BPE tokenizer. Quick local compat check: `compat-check --model Synapse-7B-v2 --tokenizer bpe --quant int4` -> PASS except kernel mismatch on rmsnorm matmul path. Stack trace points to kernel fallback -> extra latency.
sarah_infra: From infra side: Dedicated pool OK. For p95 <120ms with int4 and 7B we need either 1x A10G with NVLink for batching or 2x A100-p4s if they want higher concurrency. KMS: Dedicated can integrate customer keys via our KMS-proxy, but Private (VPC) is required for HSM-backed customer keys.
manny_sales: Pricing ask from customer: incremental monthly for Dedicated POC (baseline pool, reserve 200k tokens/day buffer + bursts to 1M). Ballpark?
elaine_devx: Ballpark only — depends on pool size. Rough estimate: $6–9k/mo for a small dedicated pool + $1.2k/mo for reserved slot + token usage. I'll flag @finance for exact quote.
sec_bot: Security checklist reminder: need SOC2 attestation, encryption-at-rest details, and data residency confirmation. Also ask customer to complete section 3 of the vendor security questionnaire (KMS, key rotation, access controls).
jordan_ml: On the shim: runtime team can add a small kernel mapping for RMSNorm -> existing optimized path (should remove fallback). Patch is trivial but needs QA perf run. I can draft PR and perf numbers. Expected turnaround ~3 business days. Example config we'll use for POC: ```
model: Synapse-7B-v2
variant: synapse-7b-v2-int4
quant: int4
tokenizer: bpe
runtimes: [dedicated]
kv_cache: enabled
optimizations: [rmsnorm-kernel-mapping]
```
elaine_devx: Action items: 1) @jordan_ml open runtime PR for rmsnorm mapping + perf report. 2) @sarah_infra open infra ticket for Dedicated pool sizing + KMS-proxy setup. 3) @manny_sales send customer a conditional quote and security questionnaire section 3.
sarah_infra: Opening INFRA-4721 for pool + KMS-proxy, will include estimated infra cost. Tagging deploy-bot to schedule canary run once PR merged.
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: job/synapse-poc-canary in 48h after PR merge.
manny_sales: Got it — I'll tell Synapse Labs: tentative yes, perf shim in progress, need signed SOW and security Q filled. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
elaine_devx: I'll follow up with a concise runbook for the POC (model tarball handling, config snippet above, expected perf metrics). Will post in this thread when ready.
